requirements.requirement: The system must execute unit tests validating that the comparison schema mapping correctly transforms backend EVAL-COMPARE responses into the defined frontend contract.
The system must execute unit tests verifying normalization logic produces consistent scores across providers with different raw scales.
The system must execute unit tests verifying ranking logic correctly orders providers based on normalized scores.
The system must execute UI tests confirming that two providers render side-by-side with correct names, scores, and measures.
The system must execute UI tests confirming that three or more providers render correctly without layout breakage.
The system must execute UI tests verifying that strengths and weaknesses indicators are displayed correctly based on computed deltas.
The system must execute tests validating correct rendering when one provider has missing measure data.
The system must execute tests validating correct handling when providers have unequal sets of measures.
The system must execute tests verifying loading state is rendered when API data is not yet available.
The system must execute tests verifying error state is rendered when the comparison API call fails.
The system must execute tests confirming that schema mapping gracefully handles null or undefined provider fields without crashing.
The system must execute tests verifying that comparison logic produces deterministic outputs for identical input data.
The system must execute tests verifying that UI rendering remains stable when providers have identical scores.
The system must execute tests validating that accessibility attributes (e.g., labels or roles) are present on comparison UI elements.
The system must execute tests verifying that LLM-generated comparison summaries (if present) accurately reflect the underlying score differences without contradiction.
The system must execute tests ensuring LLM-generated text does not fabricate measures or scores not present in the input data.
The system must execute tests verifying LLM output remains consistent for the same structured input (no nondeterministic contradictions across runs).
The system must execute tests validating that LLM summaries correctly highlight the highest and lowest performing providers.
The system must execute tests ensuring LLM summaries handle missing or incomplete provider data without generating misleading conclusions.
The system must execute tests verifying that LLM-generated comparison language avoids absolute claims when differences are marginal.
